scope: Source/asset inspection and discrete native PIE screenshots; normal map reload plus PIE restart in the same editor process.
symptom: Circular terrain patch visible through asphalt close to a near-vertical camera ray; appearance changes with distance and angle.

active_source_findings.explanation: For very small projected lateral parallax the function returns before applying PDO; the upstream POM WPO raise remains. A near-vertical camera can therefore reveal the raised terrain above the road.
active_source_findings.legacy_correction: The old DisplacementAmount/DisplacementManage outputs are not the active POM WPO in this master. Their values and distance circle were an initial, rejected causal explanation.

fix.effect: Moves the POM reference so relief works below the nominal terrain surface; retains POM and its relief depth.
fix.coverage: Terrain material of the entire RoadLab, including areas outside roads. No dedicated road-only material mask.

visual_checks.observed: Same camera location and angle; patch absent.
Inspected close asphalt view; patch absent.
Inspected overview of three roads; no circular asphalt patch.
Patch absent after saved map was actually reloaded and normal PIE restarted.

negative_and_recovery_cases.case: Legacy DisplacementAmount and DisplacementAmountSlope set to1
negative_and_recovery_cases.outcome: The patch remained; these overrides were removed.
Switching off the path removed the patch, but the final fix keeps both switches enabled.

negative_and_recovery_cases.case: Raw parent replacement on an active terrain MID
negative_and_recovery_cases.outcome: D3D12 access violation; editor restarted. No changed map/material assets were saved by this failed comparison.

negative_and_recovery_cases.case: Material-graph copy and local mask attempt
negative_and_recovery_cases.outcome: HLSL translator assertion through ShaderWorldLayerSample; editor restarted. No graph/map change from this attempt was saved; the final fix uses a regular material instance.
The native ObjectTools edit did not mark the level dirty. A real level reload restored the original material. Corrected through a reversible native actor edit, saved, reloaded and checked again.

negative_and_recovery_cases.case: Unsaved third road before diagnostic crash
negative_and_recovery_cases.outcome: Rebuilt from the two read-back positions, saved with the existing roads, and loaded in normal PIE. Its rebuilt actor has a new identity; historical ID preservation is not claimed.

limits: Discrete inspected frames, not exhaustive angles or endurance testing.
Material comparisons did not rerun earlier collision/vegetation cold-process tests.
Normal PIE restart is not a new operating-system game process.
Visible memory-pressure warnings in some native screenshots were not a performance diagnosis or a resolved condition.
sanitization: No user machine paths, actor GUIDs, save files, raw crash logs, licensed plugin source or Unreal assets included.
